description: This file implements URL parsing and encoding/decoding functionalities, including methods for URL parsing, encoding, decoding, base64 encoding/decoding, and URL text reconstruction. It defines a class URL within the Core namespace which handles URL components like scheme, host, path, query, username, and password.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: A class for parsing and constructing URLs, holding components such as scheme, host, path, query, username, and password. Provides methods for URL encoding, decoding, and string representation.

methods.name: uint16_t Encode(const TCHAR * source,const uint16_t sourceLength,TCHAR * destination,const uint16_t destinationLength)
methods.description: Returns a URL-encoded version of the input string.

methods.name: uint16_t Decode(const TCHAR * source,const uint16_t sourceLength,TCHAR * destination,const uint16_t destinationLength)
methods.description: Returns a URL-decoded version of the input string.

methods.name: uint16_t Base64Encode(const uint8_t * source,const uint16_t sourceLength,TCHAR * destination,const uint16_t destinationLength,const bool padding)
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a base64 string.

methods.name: uint16_t Base64Decode(const TCHAR * source,const uint16_t sourceLength,uint8_t * destination,const uint16_t destinationLength,const TCHAR * ignoreList)
methods.description: Decodes a base64 string into binary data.

methods.name: void Parse(const TextFragment & urlStr)
methods.description: Parses a URL string into its components (scheme, host, path, query, ref, username, password).

methods.name: void ParseDomain(const Core::TextFragment & url)
methods.description: Parses the domain part of a URL into hostname and port.

methods.name: string Text() const
methods.description: Constructs and returns the string representation of the URL.

methods.name: uint32_t CopyFragment(TCHAR * destination,const uint32_t maxLength,uint32_t index,const string & data)
uint32_t FindNext(const TextFragment & url,const uint32_t start,const uint32_t end)
